title: SOF Report Specification (SOFRS) v1.0
description: Versioned machine-readable contract for reports emitted by the Paper XII SOF Diagnostic Protocol.

sofrs_version.description: SOF Report Specification version used by this artifact.

sectorization.description: Sector origin, construction rule, dimensions or probe classes, and realization status.

observable_family.description: Named structural, behavioral, failure, operator, kernel, transition, or registered analogue observables.

support_matrix.description: Direct cross-sector support or a clearly labeled behavioral support analogue.

bridge_matrix.description: Length-two, commutator, word-depth, routing, or protocol bridge data.

repair_matrix.description: Frozen-to-active pairs or registered repair transitions with layer or step metadata.

wall_record.description: Wall events and any trajectory summary associated with a supplied deformation path.

claim_status.description: Controlled claim class for the report as a whole.

claim_note.description: Optional human-readable qualification of the controlled claim status.

failure_modes.description: Applicability warnings and known interpretation boundaries. Use an empty array only when none are known.
